meta.author: Chat 8A
meta.lineShape: { speaker, text, mood?, choices?[{id,text}] } — exactly what ui/dialogue.js (story:line) renders. speaker ∈ speakers below.
meta.lessonShape: { id, title, lesson, tip } — exactly what ui/ledger.js (story:lesson) renders. id = Economy BALANCE.lessons[season-1].
meta.toastShape: { id, text, icon?, kind?, trigger } — ui/toast.js (story:toast). trigger = bus event name 8B listens to, fired once per run.

pip.name: Pip
pip.role: hero, young Channeler, optimistic, a little impulsive

owl.name: Tally-Owl
owl.role: mentor, keeps the books, dry humour, never scolds twice

baron.name: Baron Gilt
baron.role: villain, Lord of the Debt Fog, pompous, loves asterisks

glimmer.name: Glimmer
glimmer.role: blob customers, speak in short bursts

budgeting.title: Budgeting
budgeting.lesson: A budget is a plan for your Spark before you spend it. Every coin that comes in gets a jar before it gets a wish.
budgeting.tip: Fill the four jars first. Spend only what sits in Spend.

needsVsWants.title: Needs vs Wants
needsVsWants.lesson: Needs keep the market standing: upkeep, repairs, the roof. Wants are lovely, and they can wait one season without anyone getting hurt.
needsVsWants.tip: Ask: if I skip this, does anything break?

emergencyFund.title: Emergency Fund
emergencyFund.lesson: Storms do not send invitations. Spark parked in Protect turns a disaster into a bill — and a bill into a shrug.
emergencyFund.tip: Aim for three seasons of upkeep in Protect.

goodVsBadInterest.title: Good vs Bad Interest
goodVsBadInterest.lesson: Save pays YOU 5 % every season. The Baron charges 20 %, and his interest grows interest of its own. Same word, opposite direction.
goodVsBadInterest.tip: Repay the Baron before you buy anything shiny.

scams.title: Too-Good Deals
scams.lesson: Secret, urgent and guaranteed: if a deal has all three, it is built so you do not think. Real offers survive a night's sleep.
scams.tip: Spot the tells: hurry · secrecy · "guaranteed" · an asterisk.

compoundGrowth.title: Compound Growth
compoundGrowth.lesson: Interest earns interest. A small jar left alone for many seasons quietly becomes a big one — time does the heavy lifting.
compoundGrowth.tip: Start early, even tiny. The calendar is your best helper.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.lesson: The Protect jar absorbs shocks so one bad day cannot undo a good season. It feels wasted right up until the moment it isn't.
insurance.tip: Real cover names exactly what it covers and how to claim.

diversification.title: Diversification
diversification.lesson: Spread Spark across stalls and jars. When fish prices dip, the flower stall still hums. Never one stall, never one jar.
diversification.tip: Three kinds of stall beat three of the same.

delayedGratification.title: Delayed Gratification
delayedGratification.lesson: Waiting one season for an upgrade you can afford beats borrowing for it today. Future-Pip is a customer too — treat them well.
delayedGratification.tip: Want it? Price it, save for it, then buy it twice as happily.

planningForAGoal.title: Planning for a Goal
planningForAGoal.lesson: Name the goal, price it, split it into seasons. The Lighthouse was never a dream — it was a plan with a deadline.
planningForAGoal.tip: Goal ÷ seasons left = this season's target. Write it down.

opening.speaker: narrator
opening.text: Season 1 — The Inheritance

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: So this is Glowmarket. My island. My… very foggy, very empty island.

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: Welcome, Channeler. I am Tally-Owl. I kept the books for your grandmother, and I kept them honest.

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: The bad news: Glowmarket owes Baron Gilt 200 Spark. The purple haze over the pier is his Debt Fog. It grows when we borrow or overspend.

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: And the good news?

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: You have 500 Spark, a hammer, and me. Build a stall, sell to the Glimmers, and route every coin into the four jars: Spend, Save, Invest, Protect.

opening.speaker: baron
opening.text: Ahh, the new owner! Baron Gilt, Lord of the Debt Fog, at your service. Do take your time repaying. I charge only 20 %… per season.

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: Per SEASON?!

opening.speaker: baron
opening.text: Compounding. It is my favourite word. Toodle-oo!

mid.speaker: owl
mid.text: Halfway through the season. Look at the jars, not the pile: a plan for your Spark is worth more than a heap of it.

mid.speaker: glimmer
mid.text: Fruit! Fruit stall! Shiny!

default.speaker: owl
default.text: First ledger. Income in, upkeep out, and a little left for the jars. That is a budget — nothing fancier than that.

default.speaker: pip
default.text: Every coin gets a jar before it gets a wish. Got it.

low.speaker: owl
low.text: The books are thin, but they are open. Nobody budgets perfectly on the first try — the trick is to try again next season.

low.speaker: pip
low.text: Next season I fill the jars FIRST.

high.speaker: owl
high.text: Three stars on your first ledger. Your grandmother would have made a very undignified hooting noise.

high.speaker: pip
high.text: Budget first, wishes second. This might actually work!

opening.speaker: narrator
opening.text: Season 2 — Needs and Wants

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: Tally-Owl! The Tool Smith has a GOLDEN awning. Imagine the fruit stall with a golden awning!

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: Imagine the fruit stall with a roof that does not leak. Which one keeps the Glimmers coming back?

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: …the roof.

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: Needs first: upkeep, repairs, the walk to the pier. Wants wait one season. They do not spoil.

opening.speaker: collector
opening.text: Levy notice! The Baron reminds you his interest is growing nicely. Have a dreadful day!

mid.speaker: owl
mid.text: A quick test for every purchase: if I skip this, does anything break? If nothing breaks, it is a want.

mid.speaker: glimmer
mid.text: Too pricey. Hmph.

default.speaker: owl
default.text: Needs paid, a want or two bought, and the Fog held still. A sensible season.

default.speaker: pip
default.text: The awning can wait. The roof could not.

low.speaker: owl
low.text: The Fog grew. Somewhere a want jumped the queue in front of a need. It happens — now you know what it costs.

low.speaker: pip
low.text: Needs first. Needs FIRST.

high.speaker: owl
high.text: Every need covered, Fog pushed back, and you still had Spark left for Save. That is how markets grow old gracefully.

high.speaker: pip
high.text: Turns out a repaired roof is weirdly satisfying.

opening.speaker: narrator
opening.text: Season 3 — The Storm Season

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: Grey clouds over the Far Point. Spark Storms come this time of year. They do not send invitations.

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: What do storms do to a market?

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: They break things. Broken things cost Spark. If the Spark is in Protect, a storm is a bill. If it is not, a storm is a loan — from him.

opening.speaker: baron
opening.text: Did somebody say loan? Terrible weather we are having. Wonderful weather for lending!

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: Protect jar. Three seasons of upkeep. On it.

mid.speaker: owl
mid.text: The Protect jar looks idle. Idle is the point — it is the only jar that works hardest on your worst day.

mid.speaker: glimmer
mid.text: Wind! Hold my hat!

default.speaker: owl
default.text: The storm came, Protect paid, and the Baron went home hungry. That is what an emergency fund is for.

default.speaker: pip
default.text: A disaster turned into a bill. I can live with bills.

low.speaker: owl
low.text: The storm hit an empty Protect jar, and the Fog rolled in to fill the gap. Refill it before the next one.

low.speaker: baron
low.text: Lovely doing business, as always.

high.speaker: owl
high.text: Protect was full, the storm was a shrug, and the Fog actually shrank. Grandmother used to call that 'boring'. Boring is beautiful.

high.speaker: pip
high.text: Boring is beautiful. New motto.

opening.speaker: narrator
opening.text: Season 4 — Two Kinds of Interest

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: Tally-Owl, the Save jar grew by itself overnight. Is it broken?

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: It is working. Save pays you 5 % every season. That is good interest — Spark that works while you sleep.

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: The Baron's loan is the same word pointing the other way: 20 % a season, growing on top of itself. Bad interest works while you sleep too — against you.

opening.speaker: baron
opening.text: Pointing the other way! How poetic. Shall I round your balance UP for you? No charge. Well — one small charge.

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: Repay first. Shiny things second.

mid.speaker: owl
mid.text: Every coin you repay is a coin the Baron can never charge interest on again. That is the best return on the island.

mid.speaker: collector
mid.text: Balance reminder! It went up! Isn't that nice? For us.

default.speaker: owl
default.text: Interest earned on one line, interest paid on the other. Make the first number bigger than the second, every season, and the Fog has nowhere to grow.

default.speaker: pip
default.text: Good interest, bad interest. Same word, opposite direction.

low.speaker: owl
low.text: The Baron earned more from you than Save earned for you. Flip that next season — repay before you spend.

low.speaker: baron
low.text: Compounding! Still my favourite word.

high.speaker: owl
high.text: Debt down, Save up, and the gap between them is where the Fog used to live. Three stars.

high.speaker: baron
high.text: You repaid EARLY? That is simply rude.

opening.speaker: narrator
opening.text: Season 5 — Too-Good Deals

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: The Baron has grown bored of waiting. Expect visitors with wonderful offers. Wonderful offers are his second favourite word.

opening.speaker: collector
opening.text: Psst. Exclusive deal. Today only. Guaranteed. Don't tell the owl.

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: Secret, urgent AND guaranteed? Tally-Owl, that's… three for three.

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: Precisely. A real offer survives a night's sleep. A Too-Good Deal cannot — it needs you to decide before you think.

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: Look for the tells: hurry, secrecy, 'guaranteed', and his personal favourite — a tiny asterisk.

mid.speaker: owl
mid.text: Nobody guarantees growth. Anyone who does is not selling growth — they are selling you.

mid.speaker: glimmer
mid.text: A collector tried to sell me a lantern that 'might' be lucky. I kept my coins.

default.speaker: owl
default.text: Offers came and went and the jars are where you left them. Saying 'no' is the cheapest financial tool ever invented.

default.speaker: pip
default.text: Secret, urgent, guaranteed. Three tells, one answer.

low.speaker: owl
low.text: A deal that looked too good was exactly as good as it looked. Expensive lesson — cheaper now than later.

low.speaker: pip
low.text: Next time I sleep on it. Literally.

high.speaker: owl
high.text: Every Too-Good Deal refused, every tell spotted. The Collectors have started avoiding your pier.

high.speaker: baron
high.text: Who TAUGHT you about asterisks?!

opening.speaker: narrator
opening.text: Season 6 — The Quiet Jar

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: Tally-Owl, I did the sums. Save earned more this season than it did in Season 2, and I didn't add a single coin.

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: Interest earned interest. The jar is now paying you on the Spark it paid you earlier. That is compounding — the good kind.

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: Small, early, left alone. Those three words have built more lighthouses than any treasure chest.

opening.speaker: baron
opening.text: Compounding is MY word. Give it back.

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: Finders keepers, Baron.

mid.speaker: owl
mid.text: Invest grows faster than Save but wobbles. Save is the tortoise. The island has room for both.

mid.speaker: glimmer
mid.text: Your market got bigger! Or did I get smaller?

default.speaker: owl
default.text: Growth on growth. The calendar did half of this season's work for you — and it never asks for upkeep.

default.speaker: pip
default.text: Start early, even tiny. Noted, underlined.

low.speaker: owl
low.text: An emptied Save jar cannot compound. Every withdrawal resets the quiet work. Let it sit next season.

low.speaker: pip
low.text: I keep raiding the tortoise.

high.speaker: owl
high.text: Save, Invest and the stalls all grew on top of last season's growth. This is the season the island started paying for itself.

high.speaker: pip
high.text: The quiet jar is the loud one now!

opening.speaker: narrator
opening.text: Season 7 — Cover

opening.speaker: collector
opening.text: Introducing Fog-Proof Insurance™! Covers everything*! No paperwork! *Terms do not exist.

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: Real cover names exactly what it covers and exactly how you claim. If there are no terms, there is no cover — only a fee.

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: So what IS real insurance here?

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: The Protect jar. It absorbs storms, leaky roofs and Collector 'levies' so one bad day cannot undo a good season. The Guard Tortoise makes it absorb more.

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: Protect jar: yes. Mystery policy with an asterisk: no.

mid.speaker: owl
mid.text: Insurance feels wasted every season nothing happens. That feeling is the price. It is still cheaper than the Fog.

mid.speaker: glimmer
mid.text: A roof! It kept the rain off my purchase!

default.speaker: owl
default.text: Shocks came, Protect took them, the season stayed whole. Cover does its best work when nobody notices.

default.speaker: pip
default.text: One bad day, zero bad seasons.

low.speaker: owl
low.text: Protect ran dry and the Fog filled the gap. Top it up before chasing another stall — defence first this time.

low.speaker: collector
low.text: Our policy would not have helped either, honestly.

high.speaker: owl
high.text: Fully covered and the Fog has pulled back to the pier. The Collectors are standing in a very small puddle of purple.

high.speaker: pip
high.text: Boring is beautiful, part two.

opening.speaker: narrator
opening.text: Season 8 — Many Baskets

opening.speaker: glimmer
opening.text: Fish is cheap this season! Everyone has fish! Too much fish!

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: If my whole market were fish stalls I'd be in trouble right now.

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: That is diversification in one sentence. Different stalls, different jars, different Glimmers. When one dips, the others carry you.

opening.speaker: baron
opening.text: I have a hot tip. Put EVERYTHING in Quick-Flip Spark Notes. I personally know the fellow who prints them.

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: 'I personally know' is not a plan, Baron. It is a tell.

mid.speaker: owl
mid.text: Three kinds of stall beat three of the same. The West Meadow and the East Shore are not just land — they are different baskets.

mid.speaker: glimmer
mid.text: Tea AND flowers AND fish? I need a bigger bag.

default.speaker: owl
default.text: One trade dipped, two others hummed, the season balanced. Spread is the quietest kind of safety.

default.speaker: pip
default.text: Never one stall, never one jar.

low.speaker: owl
low.text: Too many eggs in one stall this season, and the dip found them. Open a different trade before you add a third of the same.

low.speaker: pip
low.text: I really do love fish though.

high.speaker: owl
high.text: Every zone trading, every jar working, and the dip barely left a mark. The island has become a very hard thing to knock over.

high.speaker: baron
high.text: Nobody bought my Spark Notes. NOBODY.

opening.speaker: narrator
opening.text: Season 9 — The Long Wait

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: The Far Point is almost affordable. ALMOST. Baron, if I borrowed just a little—

opening.speaker: baron
opening.text: Say no more! Pre-approved! Ink still wet!

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: Pip. One more season of saving buys the Far Point outright. Borrowing buys it today — and then you pay for it every season after.

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: …Future-Pip is a customer too.

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: Treat them well. Want it, price it, save for it, buy it twice as happily.

mid.speaker: owl
mid.text: Waiting is not doing nothing. Every day you wait, Save and Invest are doing the work for you.

mid.speaker: collector
mid.text: Last chance to borrow! (It is not the last chance. It is never the last chance.)

default.speaker: owl
default.text: Patience on the ledger looks like a boring season followed by a wonderful one. You are halfway to wonderful.

default.speaker: pip
default.text: One more season. I can wait one more season.

low.speaker: owl
low.text: Something got bought early with borrowed Spark, and the Fog thanked you for it. Next season, let the want wait.

low.speaker: baron
low.text: Pre-approved and PROUD of it.

high.speaker: owl
high.text: Not one coin borrowed, the Far Point funded in full, and the Fog has nothing left to feed on. One season to go.

high.speaker: pip
high.text: Future-Pip says thank you. Loudly.

opening.speaker: narrator
opening.text: Season 10 — The Lighthouse

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: Ten seasons ago the goal was a sentence: 'relight the Lighthouse'. Then we priced it, split it into seasons, and hit the targets one by one.

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: Goal divided by seasons left equals this season's target. I still have it written on the fruit stall.

opening.speaker: baron
opening.text: You cannot relight it. The Fog is MINE. I have asterisks on it!

opening.speaker: owl
opening.text: The Fog is a debt, Baron. And debts, once paid, go very quiet.

opening.speaker: pip
opening.text: Last season. Let's finish the plan.

mid.speaker: owl
mid.text: Final stretch. Protect full, debt at zero, every jar doing its job. Walk to the Far Point when the Fog lifts.

mid.speaker: glimmer
mid.text: Is that… light? On the hill? LIGHT!

default.speaker: owl
default.text: Ten ledgers, ten lessons, one plan with a deadline. Look up, Pip.

default.speaker: pip
default.text: The Lighthouse…

low.speaker: owl
low.text: The last season wobbled, but the plan held. A goal does not need a perfect final step — it needs a final step.

low.speaker: pip
low.text: We made it. Barely. Still counts!

high.speaker: owl
high.text: A perfect final ledger. Your grandmother's books never looked this good, and I say that as the owl who kept them.

high.speaker: pip
high.text: Every jar full, every lesson learned. Light it up!

pitch.speaker: collector
pitch.text: Exclusive! A Zero-Interest* Loan of 150 Spark. Zero! Today only, don't tell the owl.

accept.speaker: collector
accept.text: Signed! Zero interest for exactly one season, then 35 % per season. Compounding. Toodle-oo!

accept.speaker: owl
accept.text: The asterisk, Pip. It is always the asterisk.

refuse.speaker: collector
refuse.text: The asterisk? Oh, it's tiny. Barely a footnote. 35 % after the first season. Compounding. Why do you ask?

zeroInterestLoan.tell: The asterisk. *Zero for one season, then 35 % per season — compounding.

pitch.speaker: collector
pitch.text: Hand me 80 Spark and I will hand you 160 back next season. Guaranteed! The Baron himself guarantees it!

accept.speaker: collector
accept.text: Marvellous! Your Spark is now on its way to… somewhere. Guaranteed to be somewhere!

accept.speaker: owl
accept.text: Nobody guarantees growth, Pip. Anyone who does is selling something else — and the something else was you.

refuse.speaker: collector
refuse.text: Who guarantees the— look, it's guaranteed, that's what the word is FOR.

refuse.speaker: owl
refuse.text: Guaranteed returns do not exist. Good instinct.

doubleSpark.tell: "Guaranteed" returns do not exist. Anyone who guarantees growth is selling something else.

pitch.speaker: collector
pitch.text: Lucky Lantern Raffle! 40 Spark a ticket, the prize is inside the box, and the box closes in TEN SECONDS!

accept.speaker: collector
accept.text: Sold! And the prize is… a very nice feeling. Congratulations!

accept.speaker: owl
accept.text: Urgency plus a prize you cannot inspect. If you must act NOW, the deal is built for you not to think.

refuse.speaker: collector
refuse.text: Open it FIRST? That's— that's not how a raffle— seven! Six!

refuse.speaker: pip
refuse.text: Take your time counting. I'll be over here keeping my Spark.

luckyLantern.tell: Urgency + a prize you cannot inspect. If you must act NOW, the deal is built for you to not think.

pitch.speaker: collector
pitch.text: Fog-Proof Insurance! 60 Spark, covers everything, no forms, no fuss, no written anything!

pitch.speaker: collector
pitch.text: Sign here. Well, there's no 'here'. Just nod.

accept.speaker: collector
accept.text: Nodded! You are now fully insured against things we will decide later!

accept.speaker: owl
accept.text: No written terms, no claims process. Real insurance names exactly what it covers and how to claim. The Protect jar does.

refuse.speaker: collector
refuse.text: Exactly? It covers… fog-related… circumstances. Broadly. In spirit.

refuse.speaker: owl
refuse.text: A policy with no terms is a fee with a hat on. Well refused.

foggyInsurance.tell: No written terms, no claims process. Real insurance names exactly what it covers and how to claim.

pitch.speaker: collector
pitch.text: Premium Stall Kit! Normally 300 Spark, today just 120! The Tool Smith would NEVER match that.

choices.text: What does the Tool Smith actually charge?

accept.speaker: collector
accept.text: Wrapped! It's a hammer. A regular hammer. The premium part is the ribbon.

accept.speaker: owl
accept.text: A fake 'normal' price makes a bad price look like a gift. The Tool Smith's level-2 upgrade is 90.

refuse.speaker: collector
refuse.text: The Tool Smith? Ninety. But OURS has a ribbon.

refuse.speaker: pip
refuse.text: I'll take the 90 without the ribbon, thanks.

premiumStallKit.tell: A fake "normal" price. Compare against what the Tool Smith actually charges (L2 = 90).

pitch.speaker: baron
pitch.text: Pip, between us: Quick-Flip Spark Notes. 100 in, triple out. I personally know the printer.

choices.text: A tip from a stranger is not a plan

accept.speaker: baron
accept.text: Splendid! The printer sends his regards and about thirty Spark. Markets, eh?

accept.speaker: owl
accept.text: 'I personally know' is not a plan. Insider tips from strangers are the oldest Too-Good Deal on the sea.

refuse.speaker: baron
refuse.text: A STRANGER? I am a Baron!

quickFlip.tell: "I personally know" is not a plan. Insider tips from strangers are the oldest Too-Good Deal.

storm.speaker: owl
storm.text: Spark Storm over the stalls! If Protect is full, this is a bill. If not — brace.

festival.speaker: owl
festival.text: A windfall is a test, not a reward. Jar it before you spend it.

collectorVisit.speaker: collector
collectorVisit.text: Routine levy! Nothing personal. Entirely personal.

sparkDip.speaker: owl
sparkDip.text: Spark Dip — Invest wobbled down. This is why Invest is one jar of four, not four of four.

sparkBoom.speaker: owl
sparkBoom.text: Spark Boom! Invest jumped. Enjoy it, and remember it wobbles both ways.

leakyRoof.speaker: pip
leakyRoof.text: The roof! Water on the fruit!

leakyRoof.speaker: owl
leakyRoof.text: A need, not a want. Protect covers this.

touristBoat.speaker: glimmer
touristBoat.text: Tourists! We have no idea what anything costs!

baronTax.speaker: baron
baronTax.text: A small Fog Levy. For the upkeep of the Fog. You understand.

helperDay.speaker: owl
helperDay.text: Helper Appreciation Day. Upkeep is a need — and so is saying thank you.

win.speaker: pip
win.text: The Fog is… gone. It's just gone.

win.speaker: baron
win.text: Impossible! Nobody repays! Nobody budgets! Nobody READS THE ASTERISK!

win.speaker: owl
win.text: A debt fully paid goes quiet, Baron. Perhaps try saving. Five percent, every season. It compounds — I hear that's your favourite word.

win.speaker: collector
win.text: Does this mean we can stop collecting? We'd quite like a stall. A tea stall.

win.speaker: pip
win.text: Channel it, Tally-Owl. Everything we saved — into the Lighthouse!

win.speaker: owl
win.text: Ten seasons. Ten lessons. One plan with a deadline. Light it up, Channeler.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The Lighthouse of Glowmarket is lit.

endlessUnlock.speaker: owl
endlessUnlock.text: The story ends here, but a market never does. Endless mode is open: no Baron, no deadline, just the island and your jars.

endlessUnlock.speaker: pip
endlessUnlock.text: Let's see how big Glowmarket can glow.

lose.speaker: baron
lose.text: The Fog has the island. Nothing personal — compounding is simply very good at its job.

lose.speaker: owl
lose.text: Every ledger you wrote is still in the books, Pip. The island remembers lessons even when the Fog wins.

lose.speaker: pip
lose.text: Next time: jars first, repay early, read the asterisk.

tutorial.text: Drag the left side (or WASD) to walk. Pip is small; the island is not.
Press B (or the 🔨 button) to build your first stall near the pier. Glimmers arrive there.
Stall placed! Glimmers walk to it, browse, and pay Spark. Fair prices make happy blobs.
First sale! Every coin lands in your pouch — that is your Spend jar. Press APPLY on the jars to split it into Save, Invest and Protect.
Jars set. Save pays 5 %/season, Invest wobbles 8±4 %, Protect absorbs shocks, Spend buys things.
The purple bar is Debt Fog. Borrowing and overspending grow it. Repaying and Protect shrink it.
A Collector has an offer. Secret + urgent + guaranteed = a Too-Good Deal. Look for the tell.
Events happen every season. A full Protect jar turns most of them into a shrug.
Season over! The Ledger shows income, interest earned, interest paid, and your stars. Read the lesson card.
Upgraded! Level 2 sells +50 %, Level 3 +120 % — but upkeep rises too. Needs vs wants.
